method: Construct Omega_8^-(2), its singular-vector parabolic 2^6:U4(2), enumerate the two A5 Levi classes and all invariant order-32 radical submodules, select the unique Q1920 module class, and exhaust Aut(Q) modulo ambient-normalizer automorphisms for both exact marked tuples.
scope: This exhausts the canonical singular-parabolic Q1920 class in Omega_8^-(2), for every embedding twist and both markings. It does not classify arbitrary finite completions of the moved-module amalgam.
